name: Xanthomas / xanthelasma (lipid work-up + treatment)
advice: Tests: fasting lipid profile (incl. triglycerides), TSH, fasting sugar/HbA1c, LFT, urine protein; screen first-degree relatives if cholesterol is very high. Low-fat diet, exercise and no smoking. Lipid drugs are coordinated with your physician; LFT and CK on statin.
